title: ouratea turnerae
intro: Ouratea turnerae, commonly known as Turnera, is a plant species belonging to the Passifloraceae family and native to tropical regions. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving sleep quality, and alleviating symptoms of anxiety and stress. The therapeutic actions of Turnera are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are known to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anxiolytic properties. The plant's bioactive constituents, including turnerone and ursolic acid, are believed to contribute to its therapeutic effects and health benefits.
